configurations.name: web-dev
runtimeArgs: cd apps/web && export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm use 22 >/dev/null && npm run dev

configurations.name: api-dev
runtimeArgs: cd apps/api && export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm use 22 >/dev/null && npm run start:dev
